title: Tap Tap Revenge: Coldplay Edition
notes: The Coldplay title screen and Tapulous welcome prompt render. The prompt's confirmation control was blank/unresponsive during the test, so the initial menu cannot be dismissed and gameplay was not reached.

screenshots.alt: Community screenshot: Tap Tap Revenge: Coldplay Edition
screenshots.caption: Community report, 1.0

reviewedUserReports.notes: Exact IPA reached the main menu, difficulty and song selection, then Speed of Sound gameplay with descending notes and changing score on a real ARM64 phone. Touch advanced the first-run prompt and game tutorial. A previous launch crash and missing Lua theme columns were fixed in this test build. Audible music quality, accurate note hits, full-song completion, pause/resume and long-term stability are NOT verified. Partial compatibility only, not fully playable.
